messages.subject: Dynamic default input value
parts:
I recall seeing this question before, but can't seem to find that thread.

Essentially, I want to be able to update the default value for the text input field based on some variables I have in my server.R function.

After each button click, I am doing a database call. I want to put one of the values I get into the input field (and then the user can change it as they see fit and submit).

messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: Re: Dynamic default input value
parts:
The ui.R portion:

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

headerPanel("Test"),

sidebarPanel(tags$textarea(id="feedback", name = "Feedback",cols = 500, rows = 4)),

mainPanel(tableOutput("test")
))
)


The relevant portion of the html:
<div class="row-fluid">
<div class="span4">
<form class="well">
<textarea id="feedback" name="Feedback" cols="500" rows="4"></textarea>
</form>
</div>
</div class="span8">


I was able to get this working by also adding a style="width: 1000px" option to tags$textarea.

Thanks,
Greg
